summary.text: Doyle Justus is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 41, who assumed office on January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Justus is a former agriculture teacher and farmer who served on the Lincoln County R-III School Board.

paragraphs.text: Doyle Justus was born in and lives in Troy, Missouri, and graduated from Troy Buchanan High School in 1987.
He earned a bachelor's degree in agricultural education in 1992 and a master's degree in agricultural education in 1996, both from the University of Missouri, Columbia.
His career experience includes working as an agriculture teacher, a farmer, and a sales representative for Schaeffer Manufacturing.
Justus served as a member of the Lincoln County R-III School Board.
In the Missouri House, Justus was assigned to the Conservation and Natural Resources Committee and the House General Laws Committee for 2025-2026.
For 2023-2024 he was also assigned to the Agriculture Policy Committee.
